# Adient honored as a Sustainability Leader by Nissan


9/29/26


-
-
-
-
-


-
-
-


Adient was recognized for its commitment to sustainability during Nissan’s 2026 Supplier Appreciation Event, held Sept. 23, in Nashville. Brooke Bowers, executive director of sustainability, and John Ly, sales director Nissan business unit, accepted the Sustainability Leader trophy on behalf of Adient. This honor reflects Adient’s significant impact and dedication to sustainable innovation within the automotive industry.


Kurt Wise, vice president of program management and sales, Nissan Business Unit, who was also in attendance of the ceremony expressed pride in the achievement: “This recognition demonstrates the strength of our partnership with Nissan and the alignment of our sustainability goals. At Adient, we believe that sustainability is not just an initiative but a vital responsibility, and we are honored to be acknowledged for our leadership.”


The award comes as part of Nissan’s ongoing commitment to recognizing suppliers who set benchmarks in sustainable practices. The event featured highlights of suppliers excelling in categories such as environmental stewardship, ethical practices and innovative sustainability strategies—all areas where Adient has made noteworthy strides.


Bowers, added, “This accolade is a testament to the hard work of our teams worldwide and our commitment to driving industry progress responsibly. We’re proud to partner with Nissan in shaping a cleaner, greener future for mobility.”


This recognition underscores Adient’s influence in a rapidly evolving industry that increasingly prioritizes climate-responsive technologies and ethical manufacturing processes


Congratulations to all the teams who contributed to this honor!
